documents.title: Annual plan refunds
documents.text: An annual subscription can be refunded within 30 days of its first purchase. Renewals are not refundable. The billing owner submits the request from the billing page.

documents.title: Password reset
documents.text: A password reset link expires after 20 minutes. A new link can be requested from the sign-in page. Support cannot read or set a user's password.

documents.title: Workspace data export
documents.text: Workspace admins can request a CSV data export from Settings. The export is prepared within 24 hours and the download link remains available for 7 days.

documents.title: Audit log retention
documents.text: Audit logs are retained for 90 days on the Business plan. Enterprise customers can configure a longer retention period in their contract.

documents.title: SAML single sign-on
documents.text: SAML 2.0 single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan. Workspace admins configure the identity provider metadata and test login before enforcement.

documents.title: Deleted file recovery
documents.text: Deleted files remain recoverable for 30 days. After the recovery window closes, files are permanently removed from Northstar storage.

documents.title: API request limits
documents.text: The API permits 1000 requests per minute per workspace. Excess requests receive HTTP 429. Clients should retry with exponential backoff and respect Retry-After.

documents.title: Download invoices
documents.text: Only the billing owner can download invoices from the Billing page. Invoices are issued monthly in PDF format.

documents.title: Data residency regions
documents.text: European Union data residency uses the Frankfurt region. Region choice is made when a workspace is created and cannot be changed later.

documents.title: Priority support response
documents.text: Enterprise priority support has a target first response within 4 hours for critical incidents. The target is not a resolution guarantee.

documents.title: API key rotation
documents.text: Workspace admins should rotate API keys every 90 days. After rotation, the old key remains active for 24 hours to allow a safe transition.

documents.title: Webhook signature verification
documents.text: Webhook payloads include an HMAC SHA-256 signature header. Verify the signature with your webhook secret before processing the event.

cases.question: Can I refund an annual plan after first purchase?
cases.answer: Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of first purchase. [refunds]
cases.expected_answer: Within 30 days of the first purchase; renewals are excluded.

cases.question: How long does a password reset link remain valid?
cases.answer: The password reset link lasts 20 minutes. [password]

cases.question: Who can export workspace data and in what format?
cases.answer: An admin can request a CSV data export. [export]
cases.expected_answer: Workspace admins can request a CSV export.

cases.question: How many days are Business audit logs kept?
cases.answer: Business audit logs are retained for 30 days. [audit]

cases.question: Which plan supports SAML single sign-on?
cases.answer: SAML 2.0 single sign-on is included with Enterprise. [sso]

cases.question: Can a deleted file be restored after two weeks?
cases.answer: Deleted files can be recovered for 30 days. [deletion]

cases.question: What should our client do after an API 429 response?
cases.answer: Retry with exponential backoff and respect Retry-After. [rate-limit]
cases.expected_answer: Retry with exponential backoff and respect Retry-After.

cases.question: Can any workspace member download invoices?
cases.answer: Only the billing owner can download monthly PDF invoices. [invoices]
cases.expected_answer: No. Only the billing owner can download invoices.

cases.question: Where is EU customer data hosted?
cases.answer: European Union data is hosted in Frankfurt. [regions]

cases.question: Is the enterprise urgent support four hour target a fix guarantee?
cases.answer: Critical incidents target a first response within 4 hours, not guaranteed resolution. [support]
cases.expected_answer: No. It is a first-response target, not a resolution guarantee.

cases.question: How long does an old API key work after rotation?
cases.answer: The old API key stays active for 24 hours. [keys]

cases.question: How do we authenticate incoming webhook events?
cases.answer: Verify the HMAC SHA-256 signature before processing. [keys]
cases.expected_answer: Verify the HMAC SHA-256 signature with the webhook secret.
